title: The Concept of Wave-Particle Duality
text:
Wave-particle duality is a fundamental principle in quantum mechanics stating that every particle or quantum entity exhibits properties of both waves and particles. For instance, electrons behave as distinct particles when measured but propagate through space like coherent waves when unobserved.

This inherent duality challenges classical understandings of matter, suggesting that the description of reality requires advanced mathematical frameworks. Experimental evidence, such as the double-slit experiment, consistently supports this non-classical behavior across various quantum systems.
